content.short: Least Authority provides security consulting and auditing services for Web3, blockchain, and FinTech teams.
content.description: Least Authority provides security consulting and audit services for blockchain technology by evaluating cryptographic protocols and distributed system architectures. Their practice covers smart contracts, zero-knowledge protocols, and consensus mechanisms, focusing on identifying vulnerabilities, validating design choices, and strengthening overall security posture. The expert team guides clients through every stage of the audit process—from scoping and risk assessment to remediation planning and verification—helping projects reduce risk and build trust with users.
